in box 28 x 39 x 12 cm + 1 ledger ([88] pages ; 19 x 27 cm) and 1 user's guide (1 leaf ; 17 cm)
Title from label on box lid.
"Edition of 100 copies"--Colophon, on first of 2 board sheets joined with a cloth hinge mounted inside upper compartment of box.

In 2 pockets on inside of lid: "Spinner" (board disk with printed paper label and rotating arrow) and "Rules of play" (user's guide: 6 p. of letterpress on sheet folded accordion-style, attached to board covers; 17 cm.). In upper compartment of box: game board (letterpress-printed design on 4 sheets mounted on connected cloth-covered boards; unfolds to 54 x 77 cm.) and "Ledger book" (184 p. of offset-printed forms and game board diagrams; 18 x 27 cm.). In 4 drawers below upper compartment (2 labeled "Marker shapes"; 2 labeled "Arrows, life markers, self markers" and "Templates, text strips, die"): the game paraphernalia. There are 18 board marker shapes, 15 metal arrows, 8 plastic "life markers," 1 "self-marker," 2 plastic templates, 36 wooden text strips, 1 die, 1 pencil sharpener and 3 colored pencils.
